hook_lines: This suisai wash is a hit in Japan

chalkboard.title: What People Are Saying
bullets: suisai launched in 2005 under Kanebo (now Kao) — #1 in Japan's face-wash market for 11 straight years, 30M+ units sold
This paste version launched Sep 2025 — 6 months in: 11 Best Cosme awards, 539,000+ units shipped (~269 Tokyo Towers stacked)
Beauty YouTuber Hiro Odagiri's recommendation video sparked the buzz — many @cosme reviews mention buying it because of that video
Formula: 2 enzymes (protease, lipase) + 2 micro-clays (Moroccan lava clay, kaolin) — foam it or apply directly and massage
Reviews are mixed — some miss the original's instant smoothness, but many say it leaves skin moisturized with no tightness

usage_placeholder.description: 실제로 페이스트워시를 손에 덜어 거품 내거나(또는 그대로 발라 마사지) 세안하는 장면. 튜브에서 짜낸 페이스트 질감, 거품망으로 거품 내는 과정, 세안 후 피부 클로즈업 반응 위주. 10~15초 분량이면 충분.
usage_placeholder.xiaohongshu_query: 日本 suisai 洗顔膏 酵素洗顔 试用

quotes.japanese: 小田切ヒロさんがYoutubeでオススメ品として紹介されていたので購入しました。酵素洗顔だけど毎日使っても大丈夫だそうです。泡立てネットで泡立てるとかなり泡は細かいです。洗い上がりはパウダーの酵素洗顔ほどツルっと感はありませんが、もこもこの泡が出来るのでお気に入りです！！
quotes.translation: I bought it because Hiro Odagiri recommended it on YouTube. It's an enzyme wash, but apparently it's fine to use every day. Foam it up with a net and the bubbles get really fine. It doesn't leave skin as slick as the powder enzyme wash, but I love how fluffy the foam gets!!

quotes.japanese: 小田切ヒロさんがオススメしたので買ってみました。小さなケースに入った粉末タイプが好きで幾度となく使ったことがあります。こちらの洗顔フォームは、粉末タイプのように使ったあとにすぐにツルツルした手触りを感じることはできませんでした。使い心地は、使った後の肌は割としっとりしています。私は、つっぱり感はありません。
quotes.translation: I tried it because Hiro Odagiri recommended it. I've used the powder type in the little cases many times and really like it. With this one, I didn't get that instantly smooth feeling right after use like I do with the powder version. As for how it feels, my skin is pretty moisturized afterward, and I don't get any tightness.

quotes.japanese: 小田切ヒロさんのYouTubeを観て購入してみました！テクスチャーはちょっと不思議な感覚！泡立てるともっちり柔らかくて顔への刺激もないです。これは定期的に使いたいかも！
quotes.translation: I bought it after watching Hiro Odagiri's YouTube video! The texture feels a little strange at first. Once you foam it up it's soft and fluffy, with zero irritation on my face. I might want to keep using this regularly!
